market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Hot jobs report and inflation odds near 100% drive rate-hike pricing, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. Diesel at record and geopolitical supply shocks create stagflationary pressure. Expect volatility in rate-sensitive sectors. Labor Day sales data will be key consumer signal.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive on AI-monetization leaders and energy, but rate cycle under Warsh creates headwinds for broad growth. If inflation proves sticky, Warsh's 'regime change' may force sustained higher-for-longer rates, compressing multiples. EM strength and AI revenue inflection provide structural tailwinds. 6-12 month: selective, not broad.
